en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town at the foot of a rocky hillside. In the foreground there is a prominent neoclassical-style building complex beside a road and railway or tram tracks, with additional smaller buildings and tree‑lined streets stretching toward the base of the hill. Densely packed houses climb up the slope in the background. Greek text is printed at the bottom, and a website watermark appears on the right.
